[[File:Rogue_Leader_tBoH.png|thumb|right|250px|Rogue Leader]]
[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] piloted a '''[[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]]''' as a part of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] along with [[Dak Ralter/Legends|Dak Ralter]] who served as his [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]].

==History==
Luke flew his [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] as a part of an effort to take down numerous [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT walkers]] that were approaching the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Echo Base/Legends|base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Upon realizing that their [[Ap/11 double laser cannon|laser cannons]] were completely ineffective against the walkers' armor, Luke ordered Dak to fire the [[Power harpoon launcher|harpoon and tow cable]] to ensnare the walker's legs; Dak was shot and killed by the AT-AT before he could do so. Luke ordered the other pilots to take a shot. Shortly thereafter the airspeeder shot down by an AT-AT. Luke managed to safely crash-land the vehicle in the snow. He salvaged the harpoon and cable and escaped from the wreck just before it was crushed by an AT-AT's footpad.
